subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Acentuar corretamente palavras oxítonas, paroxítonas e proparoxítonas.

components.description_pt: Identificar se uma palavra é oxítona, paroxítona ou proparoxítona pela sílaba tônica
components.description_en: Identify whether a word is oxytone, paroxytone, or proparoxytone based on its stressed syllable
components.cc_component_description: Identify the syllable boundary in a two-syllable word following basic patterns

components.description_pt: Aplicar regras de acentuação para colocar acento gráfico correto em palavras oxítonas
components.description_en: Apply accentuation rules to place correct written accent marks on oxytone words
components.cc_component_description: Apply position-based spelling rules when writing words in context

cc_matches.description: Decode two-syllable words following basic patterns by breaking the words into syllables.
Use spelling patterns and generalizations (e.g., word families, position-based spellings, syllable patterns, ending rules, meaningful word parts) in writing words.
